failure_reasons.insufficient_target_color_change: The intended object did not move sufficiently toward the target color.
failure_reasons.excessive_original_color_residue: Too much of the original binding color remains visually dominant.
failure_reasons.outside_mask_change: Pixels outside the frozen A/B mask union changed.
failure_reasons.color_leakage: Edited color leaked into another object or surrounding region.
failure_reasons.boundary_artifact: The edit introduced a material boundary artifact.
failure_reasons.texture_or_shading_destroyed: Texture, pattern, shading, or surface interpretation was materially damaged.
failure_reasons.object_identity_changed: The edited object no longer preserves its recognizable identity.
failure_reasons.target_binding_not_achieved: The intended A/B color reassignment was not achieved.
failure_reasons.prompt_or_answer_invalid_after_edit: The edited image no longer supports an unambiguous question and answer.
failure_reasons.corrupted_asset: A required cutout, image, contact sheet, or record is unreadable or inconsistent.
failure_reasons.insufficient_source_color_pixels: Too few valid source-color pixels were available for deterministic hue estimation.
failure_reasons.mask_overlap_prevents_composition: Frozen A/B masks overlap and do not permit an unambiguous shared edit.
failure_reasons.other: A failure not represented above; a human note is mandatory.
